pivot_origin.provenance: Originally reported in an X post by Michael Koczwara (@MichalKoczwara)

method: Analysis of retained internet-scanning and web-render telemetry, including explicitly requested fresh web visits to selected ARTEX services
introduction: ARTEX infrastructure hunt using favicon, console-title, response-hash, certificate, SSH, DNS and service-port pivots. The objective is to identify likely deployments and assess infrastructure relationships while keeping service identification distinct from infrastructure clustering.

assessment_model.service_identification: ARTEX confidence measures concordance between software artefacts
assessment_model.infrastructure_clustering: Certificates and SSH host keys are stronger leads than product markers but still require validation against shared hosting and historical reuse
assessment_model.pivot_origin_link: Not established means insufficient evidence, not evidence of no relationship
assessment_model.analytic_caveat: Judgements may be upgraded, downgraded or reversed as fresh, historical or contradictory evidence emerges
assessment_model.operational_disclaimer: Treat these indicators as hunting leads. Corroborate them through additional pivots and controlled testing before using them for detection, alerting or blocking. This validation workflow reduces the likelihood of false positives and helps prevent alert fatigue
assessment_model.dates: Observed timestamps within available collection windows, not infrastructure creation dates

reference_pivots.excluded: Sub2API artefacts on pivot-origin port 8080 and the non-primary public-ICO MurmurHash3 value -576220750
